ticket.subject: Cannot access account — locked out
ticket.description: I have been locked out after several failed login attempts. The password reset email never arrived.

ticket.subject: Application crashes on startup
ticket.description: Every time I open the desktop app it crashes within seconds and shows an error in the console logs.

ticket.subject: Invoice shows incorrect charge amount
ticket.description: My invoice shows $149 but my plan is $99 per month. I never upgraded. Please refund the difference.

ticket.subject: Request: add dark mode to the web app
ticket.description: I work late evenings and the bright interface strains my eyes. A dark mode toggle would be a great improvement.

ticket.subject: Checkout fails with payment error on last step
ticket.description: Defect in checkout flow. Steps to reproduce: add item to cart, proceed to payment, click Pay. Actual behavior: payment failed error. Expected: order completes.

ticket.subject: Two-factor authentication codes not arriving
ticket.description: I enabled 2FA but SMS codes stopped arriving three days ago. I cannot sign in without the code.

ticket.subject: Dashboard takes over 30 seconds to load
ticket.description: Since the last update the dashboard is very slow. It takes between 30 and 60 seconds before any data appears on screen.

ticket.subject: Charged twice for the same subscription
ticket.description: My bank shows two identical charges of $49.99 on the same day. Please refund the duplicate payment immediately.

ticket.subject: Add CSV export for reports
ticket.description: It would be very helpful to export monthly reports as CSV files for use in Excel. Currently only PDF export is available.

ticket.subject: Search returns no results for valid queries
ticket.description: Defect: search returns zero results for terms that definitely exist. Regression introduced in last week's release. Steps to reproduce: search for any known product name.

ticket.subject: General feedback on the new UI redesign
ticket.description: The redesign looks good overall but the new navigation bar is a bit confusing. A short onboarding tooltip would help new users get oriented.

ticket.subject: Critical: production API is down for all users
ticket.description: Production is down. The API is returning 503 errors for all endpoints since 09:15 UTC. Critical outage affecting all of our customers. Need immediate response.

ticket.subject: What features are included in the Pro plan?
ticket.description: I am considering upgrading but cannot find a clear comparison between Basic and Pro on the pricing page. Please send a detailed breakdown of included features.

ticket.subject: Request: native mobile app for iOS and Android
ticket.description: The mobile website works but a native app would significantly improve the experience. We need push notifications and offline access for field teams.

ticket.subject: User notification settings reset on every page refresh
ticket.description: Defect: notification preferences revert to defaults on every page reload. Steps: go to Settings, change notifications, refresh. Expected: settings persist. Actual: all settings reset.

ticket.subject: Forgot username — cannot log in to my account
ticket.description: I cannot remember my username from when I registered a year ago. The login page only accepts usernames not email. How can I recover it?

ticket.subject: Webhook integration throwing timeout errors
ticket.description: Our webhook integration has been failing with timeout errors for 48 hours. Our endpoint responds in under 200ms. The issue appears to be on your infrastructure side.

ticket.subject: How do I cancel my monthly subscription?
ticket.description: I would like to cancel at the end of the current billing period but cannot find a cancellation option in my account settings. Please guide me through the process.

ticket.subject: Request: bulk delete for old records
ticket.description: Deleting records one by one is not practical when we have thousands. A bulk-select and delete feature would save our operations team hours of work each month.

ticket.subject: GDPR request: delete my account and personal data
ticket.description: Please delete my account and all associated personal data under GDPR Article 17. Confirm the process and the expected timeline for complete data removal.

ticket.subject: Security alert: unauthorised login detected on my account
ticket.description: I received a security alert about a login from an unrecognised device and location. Please help me secure my account and review recent access logs.

ticket.subject: API rate limit errors blocking our production integration
ticket.description: Our integration keeps hitting rate limits even though we are well within the documented thresholds. This is blocking production traffic and affecting our customers.

ticket.subject: Requesting refund for annual plan purchased by mistake
ticket.description: I accidentally purchased an annual plan instead of monthly and need a full refund. I noticed the error immediately and have not used any features on the new plan.

ticket.subject: Add keyboard shortcuts for power users
ticket.description: Please add keyboard shortcuts for frequently used actions such as creating a new ticket, navigating between views, and submitting forms. Power users rely on keyboard navigation.

ticket.subject: File upload fails silently for files over 5MB
ticket.description: Defect: uploading files larger than 5MB fails with no error message shown to the user. The upload spinner disappears and nothing happens. The file size limit should be communicated clearly.

ticket.subject: Cannot change primary email address in profile settings
ticket.description: The profile settings page shows an email field but saving changes does nothing. The email address does not update and there is no error message.

ticket.subject: Memory leak causes browser tab to crash after 20 minutes
ticket.description: After using the app for about 20 minutes the browser tab starts consuming excessive memory and eventually crashes. Reproducible on Chrome and Firefox on different machines.

ticket.subject: Promo code SAVE20 not applying discount at checkout
ticket.description: I applied the promo code SAVE20 at checkout but the 20% discount was not applied and I was charged the full price. The code was advertised as valid until end of month.

ticket.subject: Request: add pagination to list API endpoints
ticket.description: Please add page and limit parameters to the list endpoints. Without pagination large datasets cause browser timeouts and excessive memory usage in client applications.

ticket.subject: Report generation fails for date ranges over 90 days
ticket.description: Defect: generating a report with a date range longer than 90 days throws a 500 server error. Steps to reproduce: set date range to 100 days, click Generate. Expected: report generated. Actual: server error.
